source: estimate: the fixed-point engine counted on an rv32im model (tools/cpu), calibrated on the factory patches measured on the test rig (2026-11-09)

cores.survey: docs/measurements/cpu-survey-2026-11-14-rig-two-core-split-off.json against -two-core.json (CI run 43551744806); the idle cost: -2026-11-05-rig-release-1.10-head.json against -rig-merged-split.json

rig.survey: docs/measurements/cpu-survey-2026-11-14-rig-two-core.json and -run.json (CI run 43551744806, the 22 patches of the 1.14 bank)

calibration.method: a scale and a fixed time per block, and a factor per factory engine (rig), fitted to the factory patches measured on the test rig (survey, fit)
calibration.survey: docs/measurements/cpu-survey-2026-11-09-rig-integration.json and -run.json (CI run 42673451565, default switches, all 30 factory patches)
calibration.fit: rig us = 1.192 x estimate before + 242 us (the 5 patches without an engine of their own: Init, Simple FM, Plucked String, 909 Kit, <7PH), so 233.4 / 1.192 cycles per us plus 1.192 x 23 + 242 us a block; the second core idle cost 1.192 x 24 us
calibration.acidM102Note: 303 Acid of M1-0.2 (b907693), one note held, peak cycles per block = 12 % of 2901 us (the ISR peak measured on the FM-1): the scale before the survey
calibration.benchNote: firmware/src/bench.c kernels (4x Q15 MAC 9 us, Q15 SVF 8 us per block, rounded down) give the same scale within a few %
calibration.note: module kits hold note 72; a square or saw oscillator costs more the higher it plays
